methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics)
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية كل درس في كتاب الطالب وكتاب النشاط.

topics.title: Describing an exhibition.
topics.sample_essay: The exhibition was held in our town last week. It was not as big as the recent fair, but it was interesting in its own way. There were many agricultural exhibits like carrots, radish, and tomatoes. The blacksmith displayed models of an airplane and a rocket launcher. The carpenter showed a radio set and hand-made statues. The exhibition was a great success.

topics.title: Write a newspaper report about a fashion show you have watched on TV.
guiding_questions: When did you watch the fashion show?
What did you like about the show?
topics.sample_essay: Last Friday, I watched a fashion show on TV. The show was amazing and full of beautiful designs. The models wore elegant dresses, modern suits, and stylish casual clothes. I liked the colorful dresses and the wonderful music. The lights and music made the show very exciting. It was a wonderful and unforgettable show.
